messages:
Ana (Design): ok folks—quick review: proposing a compact 'latency stripline' panel that sits above the heatmap. goal: surface p50/p95 lines + small per-route sparklines without stealing vertical real estate. attaching mock: https://img.redwood.dev/stripline-v2.png

Kevin (Frontend): looks clean. question: how do we order legend chips when space is tight? currently: p50, p95, median, throughput.

Mira (PM): main use case: debug latency regressions -> p95 first. maybe p95, p50, error rate, throughput. users care about tail latency first. :point_up:

Sam (Eng-Platform): implementation note: we can render dynamic chips but need a fallback compact mode for narrow widths. could collapse chips into a single summary pill with a popover.

Ava (a11y): accessibility nits: contrast on the chip text is low at small sizes, and the popover trigger needs a keyboard focus ring. also ensure aria-live updates when p95 toggles.

Ana (Design): good call. current mock shows p50 before p95 because visual balance, but i'll swap ordering to put p95 first. for collapsed state proposal: single "Key metrics" pill that expands on hover/click — label copy?

Mira (PM): copy options: "Key metrics" is generic. alternatives: "Latency + Throughput" (long), "Core metrics" (vague). prefer explicit: "p95 · p50 · err · rps" but that's dense.

Kevin (Frontend): i'd vote for a short human label + tooltip: label = "Metrics" and tooltip shows full list + mini-sparkline svg. keeps bar compact.

Sam (Eng-Platform): performance tradeoff: rendering lots of svg sparklines per row can be heavy. suggestion: prerender tiny canvases server-side or reuse a single shared canvas pattern. we should cap to N visible sparklines and lazy-load the rest.

Ava (a11y): tooltip approach ok but ensure it's accessible: role="button" for the pill, aria-haspopup="dialog", keyboard opens, and ESC closes. screen reader should get a short summary like "p95 210ms, p50 45ms" when focused.

Ana (Design): noted. also copy micro-tweak for the p95 helper text under the chart: currently says "p95 (tail)" — suggests changing to "p95 (95th percentile tail latency)" for clarity. too wordy?

Mira (PM): keep it short in-UI, but expand in the hover help. so display "p95 (tail)" and hover/tooltip shows the longer definition.

Kevin (Frontend): layout question: when time range picker is set to short windows (e.g., last 5m) the stripline becomes noisy. propose a sampling control icon next to the pill that toggles "auto-sample" vs "full-resolution". default = auto-sample.

Sam (Eng-Platform): auto-sample semantics: downsample on >1k req/s per route to maintain 200ms render budget. full-resolution should be rate-limited for enterprise customers. will add feature flag.

Ava (a11y): sampling control needs an accessible label: "Data sampling mode: automatic" and a description explaining cost/latency tradeoffs. also ensure state is announced when toggled.

Ana (Design): copy for the sampling tooltip draft: "Auto-sample reduces visual noise and keeps the dashboard responsive on high-throughput routes. Toggle to view raw data (may increase load)." any suggestions?

Mira (PM): I like it, maybe shorten: "Auto-sample: smooths data to reduce noise and keep the UI responsive. Toggle to view raw data (higher cost)."

Kevin (Frontend): code-wise we'll expose an aria-label and data-sampling attribute. example: <button aria-label=\"Data sampling: automatic\" data-sampling=\"auto\">⚡</button> — we can animate the icon between states.

Sam (Eng-Platform): note for backend metrics: exposing both sampled and unsampled series doubles ingestion cost. recommend we keep sampling on by default and only fetch raw on explicit user action. add a confirmation for large time ranges.

Ava (a11y): small UI nit: the stripline legend chips need at least 16px tap target on mobile. current mock is 12px. bump and layout accordingly.

Ana (Design): ok will iterate mock: reorder chips to p95, p50, error rate, rps; default label = "Metrics" with tooltip containing full names + sparklines; sampling icon with accessible label and short tooltip copy per Mira. increase tap targets.

Mira (PM): can we also add a quick keyboard shortcut hint in the tooltip: "Press \"m\" to toggle metrics"?

Kevin (Frontend): sure, will add. question about tests: what acceptance criteria do we want for QA?

Ana (Design): acceptance: 1) p95 is first and visually prioritized; 2) collapsed pill expands to show full metrics; 3) sampling defaults to auto and toggles fetch raw on demand; 4) accessibility: keyboard operable, aria announcements for state changes, tap targets >=16px.

Sam (Eng-Platform): logging: emit analytics event when user toggles sampling and when they expand the pill. rate-limit events to once per minute per user.

Ava (a11y): i'll draft a checklist and run a quick tab-order pass once the prototype is up.

Ana (Design): thanks — i'll push updated mock later today and link in this thread. any final thoughts? :slightly_smiling_face:

Mira (PM): maybe test with two customer personas: infra engineer vs product manager, they scan differently.

Kevin (Frontend): noted. will prototype compact CSS first and wire keyboard handlers.

ci-bot: Deploy pipeline queued for branch/stripline-ux-prototype — build 4821 started.

Ana (Design): awesome, thx all. follow-up: i'll post new mock and a short Loom showing the collapsed->expanded flow.
